summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo, but nothing was run: tests were not executed, as instructed. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property based on it, _reset clears it, capture in Progress.update and advance inside the lock, reset clears it, new TimeElapsedColumn between bar and TimeRemainingColumn); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with in-method imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entry); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn import and insertion in test_columns, expected output updated by hand-tracing clock reads). I read "test_columns" as tests/test_progress.py::test_columns, since tests/test_columns.py covers rich.columns. Expected-output changes: start frames elapsed 0:00:37 and 0:00:36, bar width 33 to 25; final frames elapsed 0:01:00 and 0:00:45, bar width 23 to 16, bar speed 2 bytes/s to 1 byte/s. Bar-run lengths were verified by grep, but the test has not been run, so it is unverified. Nothing is committed.
